messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Also, I want to exchange the jigsaw puzzle from the same order for one with the same difficulty but with 1000 more pieces, and I’d prefer an art theme over animals if possible.

Additionally, I’d like to exchange my camera for a slightly lower resolution model, but I want to keep all the other features the same. For any payments or refunds, I’d prefer to use my Visa card.

Lastly, I want to cancel just the skateboard from one of my orders. Can you help me with all of this?

{
  "message": "Absolutely—I can help, but I first need to authenticate your account. Please reply with your email address.

Once I have that, please also send the **order ID(s)** for:
1) the kid’s bicycle exchange (to a larger frame / mountain bike)
2) the jigsaw puzzle exchange (same difficulty, +1000 pieces, art theme over animals)
3) the camera exchange (lower resolution; keep other features)
4) the skateboard cancellation

After I look up your orders, I’ll confirm which ones are **delivered (for exchanges)** vs **pending (for cancellation)** and then ask for explicit “yes” before I make any changes. For refunds/payments, I’ll use your **Visa**—I’ll confirm the exact payment method on file after authentication."
